current_notice.meaning: Reported notice state. visible_label is visible disclosure only, never machine-readable provenance; yes alone does not establish timing.

deployer_role.meaning: Source role assertion; never default all systems to deployer.

evidence_status.meaning: Reported evidence state; complete means supplied evidence, not compliance.

evidence_updated_at.meaning: Date of reported evidence update; not source revision, legal effective date or retrieval time.

exposed_group.meaning: Reported exposed group; preserve exact text rather than guessing a list delimiter.

human_review.meaning: Reported review/escalation path; not evidence of completed review.

output_type.meaning: Reported output category; not a legal applicability determination.

owner.meaning: Reported system owner; not authenticated reviewer identity.

provider_role.meaning: Source role assertion: yes/true, no/false, unknown/null; not verified legal role.

record_version.meaning: Exact row version string; no fixed date/version whitelist.

system_id.meaning: Exact system business identity; never derive from position.

use_case.meaning: Reported actual use; no legal classification inferred.

evidence_ref.meaning: Exact source report reference, not proof that the underlying report was read.

evidence_state.meaning: Complete: supplied evidence, not compliance; partial: verification incomplete; conflicting: reported evidence/capture contradiction. Missing/stale remain source labels, not automatically adjudicated gaps.

notes.meaning: Exact owner/source notes; unresolved contradictions are retained.

owner.meaning: Reported owner responsible for the record.

record_type.meaning: Source-native record category, distinct from internal record_type.

reported_at.meaning: Source report date, not an invented timestamp or observation date.

status.meaning: Reported operational state; closed does not prove compliance or approval.

system_id.meaning: Exact referenced system identity; no fuzzy join.

action_id.meaning: Exact existing action business identity, distinct from generated action:v1 IDs.

approval_required.meaning: Review path only: legal -> Legal; operations -> Operations. Not an approval decision.

due_date.meaning: Existing operational deadline, never proposed date, approved date, legal effective date or assigned review date.

owner.meaning: Reported task owner; distinct from required reviewer.

source_version.meaning: Exact source version string; newer versions remain syntactically acceptable.

status.meaning: Planned/open/blocked/scheduled/closed denote operational progression, not approved/compliant/complete.

system_id.meaning: Exact source scope token; ALL is retained without expansion into invented system rows.
